items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers listed QUESTIONABLE (knee/ACL recovery) despite full practices; decision largely his; team elevated Berrios and signed Cambre as insurance.
items.why: Long-term career caution post-ACL; full practices but non-committal
items.implication: SNF monitor; if OUT, Mooney/Fields/Beckham/Berrios surge; if limited, Likely boost
items.opportunity: If OUT: WR targets to Fields/Mooney; TE Likely

items.text: Patriots officially placed WR A.J. Brown on injured reserve.
items.implication: Season-long absence minimum 4 weeks; NE WR room opens

items.text: Falcons QB Cooper Rush experienced back spasms Saturday but team confirms he will still start Sunday at PIT; Tua OUT (oblique), Penix inactive.
items.why: Tua oblique OUT; Penix not ready
items.implication: Lower ATL pass efficiency/TD rate; still start Bijan/London/Pitts but tempered
items.opportunity: Bijan volume safe; pass catchers downgraded slightly

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers officially ruled OUT for Week 1 after meniscus trim procedure; expected 1-2 weeks minimum.
items.why: Meniscus procedure on previously injured knee
items.implication: Primary TE targets shift; stream Mayer
items.opportunity: TE targets/routes open in LV offense

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (high ankle) limited practices, GTD/Q for ARI; Allgeier interesting if inactive. ETR waiver notes Allgeier as beneficiary.
items.why: High ankle sprain lingering from preseason
items.implication: Start if active but tempered; Allgeier stash/start if OUT

items.text: Cowboys placed RB Malik Davis on injured reserve (hip, surgery) and signed Israel Abanikanda from PS.
items.why: Hip injury Friday practice leading to surgery
items.implication: DAL RB depth thinned; Javonte primary with Abanikanda handcuff

items.text: Berry contrarian: CMC is a BUY LOW despite preseason usage frets and Kaelon Black looking good; attributes to banged-up preseason, long flight, weird game—not worried.
items.why: Preseason noise not indicative; historical reliability
items.implication: Hold/start confidently; buy if panicked owners sell

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty off injury report after full week of practice; good to go and expected to play lead role vs MIA.
items.implication: RB1/2 start; possible slight early workload management with Washington
items.opportunity: Workhorse carries/routes vs soft MIA run D

items.text: Silva Matchups: Lions open with committee at RB2 (Saylors/Vaki, 12 career carries combined) after Pacheco IR; Gibbs could play every offensive snap vs NO. Cam Jordan OUT upgrades matchup.
items.why: No viable RB2; dome track-meet script

items.text: Silva: With Kamara (MCL) sidelined/Q, Travis Etienne should dominate Saints Week 1 backfield vs DET; Kendre Miller/Estime fringe.
items.implication: Etienne RB2/flex smash; Kamara sit if active limited

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Isaiah Likely ranks 4th in TE FPP target last 3 yrs; with Nabers not 100% and weak WR2 options (Fields/Mooney), load Likely.
items.why: High FPP target history + Nabers uncertainty
items.implication: Strong TE stream/start if Nabers limited/OUT
items.opportunity: TE targets rise with Nabers caution

items.text: With Bowers OUT, Michael Mayer becomes primary TE option in LV; ETR/waiver notes and tiers elevate him as streamer.
items.implication: Top TE stream/waiver; TE6 range in some tiers

items.text: Berry keeping Chuba Hubbard 'open' as viable flex this week despite committee noise; Hubbard full practices.
items.why: Full week practices; Brooks groin limited/sorness
items.implication: Flex-worthy; monitor Brooks status for more volume

items.text: ETR DFS Top Plays / Rundown: Ja'Marr Chase best WR on slate (both DK/FD); Burrow healthy, pass-heavy CIN offense, soft TB CB matchups post-camp.
items.why: Alpha in high-total shootout; healthy O-line/play-action install

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace updated for Tua/Bowers news: NO@DET up in pace; MIA@LV slow slog. CHI/CAR total jumped.
items.implication: Favor DET/NO stacks; fade MIA/LV pace

items.text: Silva: Emeka Egbuka (toe) and McMillan (knee) resumed practice; McMillan DOUBTFUL boosts Godwin/Egbuka/Hurst. Irving justifiable RB2 but Gainwell/Tucker vulture risk (Irving 0 carries inside 5 last year).
items.why: Camp misses cleared for Egbuka; McMillan doubtful
items.implication: Egbuka WR3/2 upside; monitor GL for Irving
items.opportunity: Routes for Egbuka; possible GL for Gainwell/Tucker

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Saquon vs WAS (home history) avg 136.5 rush yds / 6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in all 4 games since joining PHI; WAS front still below avg.
items.why: Elite historical production vs this opponent

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Herbert FPP/attempt 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year; Alt healthy, ARI DL/secondary weak (PFF 31/26).
